decisions.reason: The water phantom for particle therapy scanning is closely related to the firm's established dosimetry and QA capabilities, so despite its niche market and staged release it is more likely to be refined than withdrawn.
A small volume ionization chamber fits directly within the firm's core measurement and calibration knowledge, giving management strong ability to interpret early market feedback and improve it.
This small volume ionization chamber also builds on the firm's deep existing expertise in radiation measurement, making continuation more likely than exit after only a short time on the market.

A standard clinical ionization chamber product line sits at the heart of the firm's established business and service infrastructure, so absorptive capacity for learning and commercialization is very high.
An ionization chamber for relative dosimetry is highly complementary to the firm's core QA and calibration offerings, which lowers the likelihood of withdrawal.
A thimble ionization chamber is a familiar and technically adjacent product for this firm, so management would usually keep it and leverage existing know-how, support, and customer relationships.
